Diego,

We can proceed — summary below.

1) NDA: We typically prefer our Mutual_NDA_v3 to reduce redline cycles. I reviewed LedgerWave’s NDA and there are a couple items we would change (term length, reciprocal obligations, and liability cap language). I recommend sending our Mutual_NDA_v3 first and offering a quick DocuSign route for LedgerWave to accept.

2) Bridge letter / report access: We can provide a SOC 2 Type II bridge letter confirming the audit period and whether a full report can be shared under NDA. Our most recent Type II covers the period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. Bridge letters should:
- State the audit firm and period (we state the firm as "Brightwater Audit")
- Confirm that the Type II report exists for the period indicated
- Note any redaction policy (customer-identifying data redacted)

3) Deliverables & timeline:
- I will upload our Mutual_NDA_v3 and the bridge-letter template (Redwood_SOC2_Bridge_Template.pdf) for Diego to send.
- If we send our NDA on DocuSign today, we can aim for countersignature by 9/3.
- Bridge letter can be prepared same-day once NDA is executed and will reference the audit period above.

Attachments: Mutual_NDA_v3.docx, Redwood_SOC2_Bridge_Template.pdf

Let me know if you want legal involved for redlines; Marcus I’m cc’ing in case there are commercial considerations.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
